text:
maya_marketing: Hey @sam_runtime — prepping the webinar slides and the launch blog. We need a small audit of the benchmark numbers before we publish. can you help with a quick sanity rerun? :pray:

sam_runtime: sure — what exact artifacts do you need? p50/p95? full trace?

maya_marketing: Ideally: p50/p95 token latency, throughput (tokens/s) for the 3 model variants we plan to show, and a short note on env (GPU type, driver, quantization). also want the sample payloads we used and the random seed so results are reproducible.

eli_product: adding context — marketing will cite two numbers in the deck: "median latency at typical request" and "cost per 1k tokens with our batching defaults". we need the rerun to use production routing and batching config if possible.

sam_runtime: ok. which models + seq lengths + batch sizes?

maya_marketing: models: rdx-7b (float16), rdx-7b-4bit, and a 13b float16. seq lengths: 64, 256, 1024. batch sizes: 1, 4, 16. payloads: short chat prompt (~30 tokens), paragraph (~120 tokens), long context (~900 tokens).

nina_research: quick note — please also capture KV cache hit/miss since marketing will claim prefix caching helps 3x in some spots. make sure to run with and without prefix cache enabled for the long-context test.

sam_runtime: got it. i'll run three variants x 3 seq lengths x 3 batch sizes x cache on/off — that's 54 runs per model. estimate ~2 hours on a single dedicated pool. i'll queue on the dev-runtime pool unless you need dedicated hardware.

maya_marketing: dev-runtime pool is fine if you can confirm there are no noisy neighbors that skew p95. if dev pool has intermittent load, please tag the run and we can re-run on dedicated.

sam_runtime: i'll run on the dev-runtime with a pinned slot (low-noise) and attach a note. will produce: results.csv, traces.zip, sample_payloads.json, env.txt (GPU, CUDA, driver, runtime commit hash), and a short writeup summarizing any variance or outliers.

maya_marketing: perfect. timeline? we want the numbers by EOD Wednesday (PST).

sam_runtime: EOD Wednesday works. i'll post interim smoke-check within 3 hours with the short/1 batch numbers so you can start slide text.

eli_product: FYI — for the cost calc use the latest quantization pricing in the sheet (link: https://redwood.co/internal/pricing/quant-models). also normalize tokens to our billing unit (per-1k).

sam_runtime: noted. i'll run the cost script and include a column "cost_per_1k_tokens" in results.csv.

maya_marketing: one more ask — please capture a tiny representative payload in the results (we'll embed it in the blog) and include any failure rate counts (timeouts, 5xx).

sam_runtime: will do. also adding a small debug snippet to the thread for clarity of the payload format:

```json
{
  "model": "rdx-7b",
  "input": "Summarize the following paragraph in one sentence...",
  "max_tokens": 128,
  "temperature": 0.2
}
```

sam_runtime: and a sample tail of the smoke log for reference:

```
[2026-11-02T14:03:12Z] RUN start model=rdx-7b seq=256 batch=4 cache=on slot=pinned-3
[2026-11-02T14:03:45Z] p50=38ms p95=120ms tokens/s=4200 errors=0
```

nina_research: when you post results, please annotate rows where GPU clocking or power limits were adjusted. those can affect p95 quite a bit.

sam_runtime: will note that. also plan to run the quantized variant with both AMX kernels and the fallback path so we can comment on any perf delta.

maya_marketing: awesome. once you post results, can you add a 2-sentence bullet we can lift into the blog describing any caveats? we'll edit for tone.

sam_runtime: yup — short human-friendly caveats plus a technical appendix with exact commands and the commit id.

ci-bot: build-notify: bench-runner job queued (id: 4521) on dev-runtime. estimated runtime: 2h 10m.

maya_marketing: thanks @sam_runtime and @nina_research — ping here if anything blocks. :rocket:
